facts.fact: The dataset lists 70 files.
Borough GeoPackages use EPSG:27700 British National Grid.
planning_local_plan_data_10.gpkg is the Enfield package and is listed at 4.29 MB.
planning_local_plan_data_16.gpkg is the Havering package and is listed at 12.09 MB.
planning_local_plan_data_22.gpkg is the Lambeth package and is listed at 3.15 MB.
The corresponding borough FeatureServer links are described as the most recent data used by the Planning Data Map.
The borough FeatureServer links are described as supporting queries.
The dataset is maintained by Greater London Authority planning/GIS functions.
The published GeoPackages are reusable under the stated public-data licensing conditions.
The GLA Site Allocations dataset contains three files.
The Site Allocations GeoPackage is listed at 5.11 MB.
The Site Allocations GeoPackage uses EPSG:27700 British National Grid.
The web service points to planning_data_map_02 MapServer layer 102.
The dataset defines a site allocation as land allocated for a particular development or use in a development plan.
Examples of allocation uses include housing, employment and leisure.
The published GIS boundaries are described as indicative.
The GLA instructs users to contact the relevant London borough to confirm boundary accuracy.
The dataset is published under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
The smallest geography is custom polygons.
The GLA dataset is a strong cross-check but positive scoring still requires borough-confirmed target geometry or feature identity.
